uiDefinition.description: Your C TWO server hostname only — no scheme, no trailing slash. For example connect24.ctwo.cloud, or an on-premises host with optional port such as ctwo.contoso.com:8443.
uiDefinition.tooltip: C TWO hostname only, e.g. connect24.ctwo.cloud

uiDefinition.description: The base path of your C TWO API including your division. Start with a slash, no trailing slash. For example /DEFAULT/CTWO.Server/api.
uiDefinition.tooltip: C TWO API base path, e.g. /DEFAULT/CTWO.Server/api

uiDefinition.description: Your C TWO API token, entered as: Bearer <your-token>. A Service Account token is recommended; a Personal Access Token also works.
uiDefinition.tooltip: Format: Bearer <your-token>. Service Account recommended; Personal Access Token also valid.
